name: What is the typical timeline for luxury duplex construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for luxury duplex construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for luxury duplex construction can vary, but generally, it involves several stages. Design and architectural planning might take 3-6 months. Permitting can add another 2-6 months, depending on local municipality review processes in areas like Los Angeles or Glendale. The actual construction phase typically lasts 12-18 months, influenced by the project's complexity, weather conditions, and material availability. Opus Builders works to streamline this process while maintaining the highest quality standards for luxury builds.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury duplex construction typically takes 12-18 months for the build itself, preceded by 3-6 months for design and 2-6 months for permitting, depending on project complexity.
